purpose: Retain and tally sourced angler observations, articles, blogs, posts and field notes without requiring independent corroboration for inclusion. Report counts represent reported activity, not independently measured fish abundance.

unverified_signal.label: Reported observation
unverified_signal.minimum: One original report is retained and counted once.

corroborated_signal.label: Multiple supporting reports
corroborated_signal.minimum: Two or more compatible underlying observations.

verified_field_evidence.label: Direct field observation
verified_field_evidence.minimum: First-hand field note recorded with available metadata.

rules: Never convert one social-media post into a location-wide bite claim.
Corroborating reports must be evaluated for independence; reposts, copied captions, or the same catch shared across accounts count as one underlying observation.
A photograph can strengthen species and location confidence but does not by itself prove abundance or persistence.
Evidence ages; current-status language must consider recency and environmental comparability.
Official regulations, closures, access rules, and health advisories are separate controlling sources and cannot be overridden by community evidence.
Every derived public statement must retain the source report IDs and generation timestamp.
methodology_note: External sources support structured observation metadata, quality control, independent validation, species/photo verification, uncertainty handling, and caution about social-media/self-reported bias. RICHFISH reliability-tier thresholds are project-defined editorial heuristics and are not presented as NOAA, GBIF, iNaturalist, or peer-reviewed statistical thresholds.

reporting_policy.inclusion_rule: All attributable fishing reports may be recorded, regardless of independent corroboration.
reporting_policy.counting_unit: One underlying event or observation; mirrors, reposts and article syndication share an event identifier.
reporting_policy.use: Summaries by location, target species, technique, bait, source category and date; distinguish source counts from unique-event counts.
reporting_policy.missing_data: Unknown dates/species remain null; never fabricate.
reporting_policy.freshness: Historical observations remain available; show age for current-action insights.
reporting_policy.hard_gates: Legal access, fishing restrictions, closures, contamination and physical safety remain distinct and authoritative.
